authority: docs/FIELD_PROXY_AUDIT_CONTRACT_20261019.md incl. the D-277 pre-review clauses (Grok P-01..P-05) + infra/paseo_proxy_audit_20261019/implementation_task.md
scope: segment 1 only: molecular and spatial consistency of the four pre-set proxy fields; no training, no candidate-field proposal, no held-out split, no use of segment-1 results to fix segment-2 members, weights or candidate counts
sections: all 72 qualified sections, 65 established units (frozen manifest); the 19 sections without a verifiable source stay in the internal description; lung cannot enter any source holdout; breast and liver sources are cross-organ
target_definition_source: infra/tls_multiscale_gobp_20261002/panel_controls.json (frozen panel; B_AXIS 49 genes, each Hallmark up to 200)
expression_source: data/other_sources/hest1k/st/{sid}.h5ad fields X, var/_index, obs/_index, obs/in_tissue only
readout_formula: gene map = log1p(1e4 * raw gene count / all-gene library of that spot); set map = arithmetic mean of those gene maps
same_formula_rule: single-gene, leave-one-out and disjoint-subset maps use the same raw counts, the same all-gene library denominator, the same tissue spots and the same frozen barcode order; only the set of averaged genes changes; zero-library spots follow the old definition and are never filled in
support_gene_reuse: infra/field_biological_review_20261019/measured_fields.tsv (reviewed support columns sup_*) with its source stated; values from a different formula are never correlated with these maps
panel_accounting: panel-absent genes (n_absent) and in-panel zero-count genes (n_in_panel_zero_counts) are reported separately; undetected is never a biological negative
measurable_gene: in panel, at least 20 tissue spots with a positive count, and a gene map with variance > 0; only measurable genes enter the within-section synergy, leave-one-out and disjoint-subset checks; defined but unmeasurable genes stay in the original proxy definition and coverage record
subset_minimum: each disjoint subset needs at least 3 measurable genes (at least 6 in total); otherwise that section x target subset consistency is NOT_ESTIMABLE with the reason and denominator kept; never relaxed for B_AXIS
technical_control: sensitivity analysis only: per spot, log1p of the total counts of all genes EXCLUDING this target's set, and the non-target gene detection fraction; each measurable gene map is regressed on those two covariates plus an intercept within the section; synergy among residual maps is reported next to the uncontrolled maps; the original proxy and the leave-one-out/subset maps are never replaced by residuals
technical_control_caveat: the regression can also remove biological signal coupled to cell density, and the shared all-gene normalisation denominator can still induce dependence; residual similarity or its disappearance cannot by itself decide biological versus technical origin

fixed_controls.split_seeds: 10 fixed per-section, per-target seeds derived from draw indices 0..9 (recorded); all draws reported as a distribution, the best-looking draw is never selected
fixed_controls.matching: out-of-target measurable genes are matched to each subset using the joint quartile bins of detection fraction and mean normalised expression; bins are defined on the section's measurable genes of the whole panel union; a single control draw samples without replacement; if a bin lacks candidates that draw's control is NOT_ESTIMABLE and the number of evaluable draws is recorded; bins are never changed and no top-up with the most similar gene
fixed_controls.role: descriptive only; never a formal significance test or an independent biological reference

geometry: frozen per-section coordinates and the empirical nearest-neighbour pitch of that section; no micrometre conversion and no super-resolution claim
barcodes: every per-section matrix is built in the frozen cache barcode order and asserted against the cache barcodes
quantile_rule: high-value spots are the strictly-above-quantile set (v > quantile(v, q)); the realised fraction is reported; it is an operational threshold, not a biological truth
unit_rule: each metric is computed per section first; if any section of an established unit is not estimable the unit's metric does not enter the complete-unit mean and the reason and denominator are kept; complete units are equally weighted; 0 is a valid value
stratification: internal 72 sections / 65 units; source 53 sections / 47 units in six sources, each source reported separately and equally weighted inside the source arm; the 19 source-insufficient sections stay internal; lung is not testable as a source; breast and liver are cross-organ
identity: only 8 within-study confirmed units; 57 units unknown and never upgraded; section counts are never reported as patient counts
no_pass_threshold: no single correlation threshold is used to name a real field; only distributions, denominators and explicit not-estimable states are reported

structural_not_testable.NO_PANEL_GENES: none of the defined genes is present in the section panel
structural_not_testable.FEWER_THAN_SIX_MEASURABLE: each disjoint subset needs at least 3 measurable genes
structural_not_testable.CONTROL_BIN_INSUFFICIENT: that control draw has too few matched candidates; the number of evaluable draws is recorded
structural_not_testable.BARCODE_OR_COORDINATE_MISMATCH: hard failure, the section is not evaluated

no_segment2_locking: segment 1 is descriptive only; nothing here selects or fixes the gene membership, weights or candidate counts of segment 2; if segment 2 is authorised it must reuse the existing split files and fit every learnable definition on training units only, assert that an established unit never crosses training and test, and never modify candidate matching or naming from test results
not_run: any model training or held-out split
human TLS labels, old manual evaluation or HookNet outputs
seed_note: fixed before computation; used only to derive the 10 per-section, per-target subset split seeds (recorded per draw)
